upstreamFrontmatter.name: hyperframes-animation
upstreamFrontmatter.description: All animation knowledge for HyperFrames — atomic motion rules, multi-phase scene blueprints, scene transitions, broader motion-design techniques, AND the seven runtime adapters (GSAP default, plus Lottie, Three.js, Anime.js, CSS keyframes, Web Animations API, TypeGPU). Use for any motion or animation task: pick 2-4 rules and compose, or load a blueprint, or look up runtime-specific API (e.g. GSAP eases / Lottie player / Three.js mixer). HyperFrames-native: single paused timeline, seek-safe, deterministic.

adaptations: Namespaced colliding or host-specific skill: hyperframes-animation -> openmontage-hyperframes-animation
Restricted to user-selected local/browser/Obsidian execution; cloud, remote-provider and foreign-runtime branches disabled.
